name: For Honor: Assassin's Creed Ultimate Hero Skin Bundle
summary:
The Assassin's Creed Ultimate Hero Skin Bundle offer includes:
1 Peacekeeper Hero Skin
1 Shinobi Hero Skin
1 Shugoki Hero Skin
1 Berserker Hero Skin
28-Day Champion Status
12 Scavenger Crates
1 Execution for Peacekeeper
1 Execution for Shinobi
1 Execution for Shugoki
1 Execution for Berserker
For all Heroes owned: Assassin's Creed Iga's Furriest Illustrious Outfit

This Assassin's Creed Ultimate Hero Skin Bundle unlocks a Shinobi and Shugoki Hero Skin of Naoe the Swift and Yasuke the Brave from Assassin's Creed Shadows; a Berserker Hero Skin of Eivor Wolf-Kissed from Assassin’s Creed Valhalla; and a Peacekeeper Hero Skin of Ezio Auditore. The bundle also grants Iga’s Furriest, an Assassin's Creed Illustrious Outfit, to all Heroes owned.
